page.overview:
Who is Pacers?

Pacers are a criminal family of lemon thugs. Some bodyguards work for Tubbs Pacer. Pacers attended the Lemon meeting in Porto Corsa. Later, they get defeated by Finn McMissile, Holley Shiftwell, and the gang from Radiator Springs.

Afterwards, they get arrested by Sheriff and Scotland Yard. Tubbs then gets spray-painted by Ramone. He tries to flee the brawl with other bodyguard lemons including a black Pacer, but they are arrested by Sarge and the British military.
